answer: Price each identity to a scarce ferrous hardware anchor that signs a fresh per-epoch proof, and let standing accrue only as already-established peers rooted in SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its vouches fold back onto itself and never span distinct clusters: those clones scatter like windblown grains on a barren dune, never taking root in the trusted grove. Honest agents root once; a farm pays a fresh anchor per head, linear per clone.
